status: Vehicle and crew filled from public sources. Radar and missile sections are deliberately empty until the engagement-model decision (docs/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md, 'Open decision') is made.

sources.wrk: 2ПВО МСД. Часть 2. Зенитные ракетные полки (зрп), unsigned article, wrk.ru forum attachment (docs/SOURCES.md)
sources.apa: Air Power Australia, 9K33 Osa/Romb ... SA-8 Gecko
sources.nuou: Ukrainian National Defence University museum page, 9A33BM Osa

crew.notes: An officer; on the battery's first vehicle, the deputy battery commander.
Sergeant, deputy crew chief. SAM Simulator: Firing Officer.
Crew of 5 also in ru_wiki (9A33B); mis and nuou give 4 for later variants.

max_road_speed_mps.notes: Sources disagree: 60 km/h on roads for the complex's vehicles (wrk), 70 km/h (ru_wiki), 80 km/h (nuou; wrk for the chassis). 70 km/h picked as the middle value.

deploy_time_s.source: wrk (within 4 min including the GTA start), gs (4 min), mis (up to 4 min)

stow_time_s.source: ru_wiki (deployment and stowing not more than 5 min)

search_on_the_move_max_speed_mps.source: wrk (search possible at up to 80 km/h)

power.value: 9И120 gas-turbine unit (on the move and at a halt); engine power take-off generator (at a halt only)
power.notes: apa writes 9I210, probably a typo. Output figures in wrk are not used by the sim.
